title: Continuation checklist for Layered Audio development
summary: Recover the current Layered Audio baseline and dependency versions, preserve semantic/runtime and intention-authority boundaries, make bounded changes, add regression evidence, run the complete suite, clean-unpack the exact ZIP, verify its manifest, and update this sphere separately from executable package state.
invariants: Do not move allocator authority into Audio.
Do not flatten uncertainty into one transcript or one best enhancement.
Do not flatten live Audio objects into an intention command catalogue or reconstruct selected objects from IDs.
Test dynamic intention addition/removal, ambiguity and exact object preservation whenever the Audio object graph or intention integration changes.
Keep Intention Service interpretation, Management federation and Storage authority separate from Audio truth.
Update this sphere when architecture, qualification baseline, durable processing doctrine, intention semantics or cross-domain federation changes.
procedure: Check current Library and GitHub heads before choosing a baseline; historical generated registers may lag current working reconciliation.
Inspect exact external public contracts before binding Audio to them; do not copy or reimplement an adjacent authority.
Run Audio regressions and strict ooRexx standards against the exact candidate when a runnable r13196 environment is available.
Record static/package evidence separately from runtime evidence and never promote predecessor runtime evidence to a new cut.
Update the Layered Audio sphere and its self-excluding manifest after architectural changes.

provenance.claim: Current intention/federation overlay static qualification evidence; fresh dev8 runtime execution pending.
